It carries the same Zr4+ and Li2O-rich chemistry as the LLZO garnet, which should limit interdiffusion and reaction at the equilibrated LLZO contact. Its oxide anion should also resist oxidation against LiCoO2 at 4.0 V. It is the closest available analog to the Li2ZrO3 and Li6Zr2O7 ideas, whose IDs were not in the available list.

proposal.hypothesis: Li3TaO4 is a Li-rich, Ta5+ oxide and a wide-gap electronic insulator. Its Li2O-rich framework should be close to equilibrium with LLZO and LiCoO2, and Ta5+ is electrochemically inert near 4.0 V. It is the closest available analog to the Nb-oxide LiNbO3 coating idea, whose available entries were not evaluated.
